seoTitle: Free Startup Cost Calculator with Runway and Buffer
metaDescription: Add one-time and monthly costs, set a runway and contingency, and see the total funding you need. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
intro: List your one-time and monthly costs, choose a runway in months and a contingency percentage, and see the monthly burn and the funding you need.
why:
First-time founders usually underestimate costs, mostly because small monthly fees add up and one-off costs are forgotten. Without a total, "how much do we need?" becomes a guess, and runway is discovered when the money runs out.

Enter each cost as a line: item, amount and whether it is once or monthly. The tool adds the one-time costs and multiplies the monthly ones by your runway, then adds a contingency buffer on top. You get the burn rate and the funding needed in one place. It is simple arithmetic with no taxes, inflation or revenue, so use it as a first-pass budget. Your figures stay in your browser.
howTo: Enter one cost per line as "item, amount, once" or "item, amount, monthly".
Set the runway in months and the contingency percentage.
Read the table, the one-time total, the monthly burn, the contingency and the funding needed.

faq.a: Many people add 10 to 20 percent. The default is 15 percent. Use a higher figure when costs are uncertain or the plan depends on hiring or hardware.
No. It only counts costs, so the result is the funding needed with no income. If you expect revenue, subtract it yourself or model it separately.

The second field is read as a number after currency symbols are stripped. Use a period for decimals and do not use commas as thousand separators, because commas separate the fields. A line without a valid amount or the word once or monthly causes an error.
No. Amounts are used exactly as entered, so include VAT and expected price rises in the numbers if they apply.
